text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What Neo Universe wanted to achieve at the 
Takarazuka Kinen wasn't just connecting 
with the Umamusume running beside her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Connecting with the audience— by putting 
on an "entertaining race," she wanted to 
bring joy to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe happily basks in the cheers 
of the crowd. However, her expression 
clouds over, realizing there are obstacles 
standing before the upcoming Kikuka Sho.
